chronicle.text: Voshe tied fiber and fiber together with fiber and was left with something to carry things in: the first carrier.
Meinis came back for food left 9 weeks before, and it was still there.
Yazukein found that what Hukahour had told them was wrong, and trusted them less for it.
Zeikoshe drank from the sea and it did not quench their thirst.
Yazukein told Vekem that Meinis could be believed: reputation passed on by word.
Vaiko went back to a thing they had made a third time, to see it happen again: the first deliberate testing.
Yazukein scratched a mark <o/|> into the ground.
Meinis gathered food that had grown where seeds had been dropped: the first harvest from seed left in the ground.
Voushoun set food aside on purpose, having found it there when it was needed before: the beginning of keeping stores.
Zeikoshe tied wood and wood together with fiber and was left with something that floats and carries someone across water: the first raft.
Meinis buried seed on purpose, having seen it come back as food: the beginning of farming.
Voushoun tied a stone flake and wood together with fiber and was left with something heavy on a handle: the first club.
Vekem struck stone with flint and stared at what happened.
Yazukein crossed open water on something that floats and came ashore on land nobody could walk to from where they set out.
Gahiyou struck flint with flint and was left with a sharp edge: the first blade.
4 people now tell that Tonoul stole from Gahiyou. It was Seshail. The story changed as it was passed on.
Reti took up striking stone with flint from a mark: the first thing learned from a record.
Reti came on the mark <.o^> and took it to mean stone being struck: the first mark read as a message.
Livor tied a club and a blade together with fiber and was left with a sharp point on a long shaft: the first spear.
Gahiyou struck flint where dry things lay, and they caught: the first fire made by people.
At (12, 31) the heap of things people had left grew big enough to keep out a fifth of the winter cold: the first dwelling. Yazukein had put in the most.
Thoshain found that what the mark <ovv> seemed to say was wrong, and put less faith in that mark.
6 people now take the mark <ovv> to go with flint being struck, and have for two years. Nobody decided this; it grew from where the mark was made and seen.
Vaiko took in the orphan Tonoul, no relation, the first time a stranger raised another's child.
4 people now take the mark <.o^> to go with water, and have for two years. Nobody decided this; it grew from where the mark was made and seen.

The mark <.o^> has drifted: it went with water, and now, for 7 people, with shelter.
Yazukein fed wood to a fire to keep it going: the first kept fire.
The mark <vv.> has drifted: it went with flint being struck, and now, for 4 people, with wood being struck.
The mark <.o^> has drifted: it went with shelter, and now, for 4 people, with flint being struck.
